surface.background: bright opaque white or very pale mint matte editorial surface
surface.alternate: pale mint field may support a white semantic nucleus while preserving high contrast
surface.finish: clean low-texture paper with no glass or luminous surface

palette_roles.hierarchy: deep forest green carries titles boundaries and the dominant editorial weight
palette_roles.active_system: saturated emerald carries the primary system action and must lead the composition
palette_roles.support: pale mint organizes subordinate structures without becoming low-contrast decoration
palette_roles.secondary_signal: one restrained cyan-green may distinguish a secondary force without displacing emerald
palette_roles.background: bright white or pale mint preserves a high-key editorial field

line_language.primary: uniform crisp three-pixel forest-green edges with mechanically consistent alignment
line_language.arrows: direct emerald arrows or active ribbons without glow wobble or sketch texture
line_language.boundaries: flat precise green-led boundaries with no dashboard chrome or ornamental circuitry

material_and_texture.surface: bright matte editorial paper with minimal texture
material_and_texture.objects: flat opaque forest emerald and pale-mint geometry with restrained four-pixel soft shadows
material_and_texture.depth: matte-flat; depth is limited to quiet separation shadows and never becomes glassy or isometric

geometry.grid: disciplined twenty-four-pixel editorial grid with active horizontal extension
geometry.nodes: wide flat geometric objects with twelve-pixel corners and crisp silhouettes
geometry.grouping: alignment and active space connect one semantic nucleus to meaningful structures in both outer bands
geometry.focal_rule: one central semantic nucleus survives square crop while left and right forces remain meaningful in the full wide frame

depth_and_camera.mode: front orthogonal flat high-key editorial composition
depth_and_camera.perspective: no deep perspective isometric environment glass extrusion or cinematic camera

typography.voice: modern sans-serif with deep forest or emerald hierarchy
typography.exact_text: titles labels and technical copy are applied deterministically
typography.generated_text: image generation keeps objects label-free and preserves a deterministic title-safe zone

density_and_spacing.density: medium-active density with a strong central nucleus and meaningful content in both outer bands
density_and_spacing.spacing: eighty-pixel outer breathing zones without empty side bands
density_and_spacing.rhythm: asymmetrical left and right forces remain balanced by one central semantic nucleus

required_traits: bright white or pale mint matte field remains opaque and high contrast
an unmistakable emerald-led hierarchy actively spans the wide canvas
one semantic nucleus survives the central square crop while meaningful structures extend into both outer bands
flat crisp geometry uses forest boundaries pale mint support and restrained cyan-green secondary signal
intentional foreground occupies roughly seventy to ninety percent of the wide composition
forbidden_traits: no leaves botanical motifs sustainability symbolism earth icons or eco-brand clichés
no pale low-contrast card piles generic dashboard widgets or UI chrome
no glassmorphism transparent panels glossy depth neon glow or dense decorative circuitry
no empty outer bands or composition shrunk entirely into the central square
no people crowd stock photography or multiple non-green competing accents

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 2 is emerald-led high-key and horizontally active across both outer bands; Style 1 is quieter neutral ink-blue with role-sensitive shallow 2.5D
